span.p:
✅ Track A: Toroidal Circular-Conv2D 5-Map PBR Pipeline
1. Inject padding_mode='circular' in UNet & VAE
2. High-pass luminance equalization (anti-blotch)
3. Intrinsic de-lighting: Albedo + Normal + ORM + 16b Height
4. Compress to BC7 / ASTC / KTX2 with Toksvig mipmaps
